name: Secured Finance (Secured.Fi lending market) exploit, c0ffeebabe.eth WBTC rescue
date_note: initial incident notes said 2026-09-07; on-chain block timestamps are 2026-09-05 22:40-23:42 UTC. TechFlow reported Sept 7, other outlets Sept 5. Chain data wins.
era: post-merge, mempool-dumpster covers the day (public mempool only)
verdict_label_detail: Our call-level comparison for c0ffeebabe.eth transactions is withheld by policy; the public traces can be compared by anyone.
verdict_reason: The attacker's public-mempool tx 0x5d4e4fa9... It is in a LATER block than the attacker's tx and the attacker had no tx pending (next attacker tx 23:25), so it neither front-ran a pending attacker tx nor shares/precedes the attacker's block: fails the confirmed-onchain test (2)/(3).  A different searcher (0xf601d764, contract 0xa2233b75) later took 16,000 USDC at 25914405 idx 0 with the same shape (Balancer USDC flashLoan + same vault) - also post-failure. Our call-level comparison for c0ffeebabe.eth transactions is withheld by policy; the public traces can be compared by anyone.
protocol_loss_note: press figure (KuCoin/TechFlow); ~0.9 WBTC (~$72k) by c0ffeebabe + 16,000 USDC by the later searcher + rest unattributed

attacker.funding_source: Tornado Cash 0.1 ETH pool 0x12d66f87a04a9e220743712ce6d9bb1b5616b8fc via relayer 0x4750bcfc...; 0.09787569644015 ETH to the attacker, block 25820022, 2026-08-23 19:42:47 UTC (13 days before)
attacker.other_activity: CREATEs on 2026-08-23 and 2026-09-05 21:26-21:34 (3 x ~2.7M gas) = probes/other targets; after the rescue: nonce 15 CREATE reverted out of gas (blk 25914402, 23:25), nonce 16 CREATE ok (blk 25914406 idx 165, no transfers), nonce 17/18 CREATE2 (23:40, 23:42); 2026-09-23 sends 0.07 ETH to Across SpokePoolPeriphery 0x97ccdbea... (the Kelp attacker also used it at nonce 0 - weak link only)

txs.status: reverted (out of gas in flashLoan callback)

victim.mechanism_reported: getMarketUnitPrice() valued collateral from current-block order-book average, manipulated with flash loan + self-trades (press, reported)

bots.label: c0ffeebabe.eth

txs.first_seen: not in mempool-dumpster (private order flow or missed)

txs.note: same contract, 203k gas, unrelated to Secured Finance victim, 1.83e-5 ETH to coinbase

captured.amount: 0.9 WBTC withdrawn from the token vault (0.91 WBTC flash-loaned from Balancer, 0.91 repaid); proceeds sold on UniswapV3 WBTC/WETH pool 0x4585fe77... for 28.84875 WETH

bots.notes: Its tx came after (not before) the attacker's failed tx. No refund from the builder to c0ffeebabe is visible in the block or in the EOA/contract internal-tx lists.

other_racers.label: later searcher
other_racers.note: Long-lived EOA since 2024. Block 25914405 delivered by Titan (0.0288 ETH). Our call-level comparison for c0ffeebabe.eth transactions is withheld by policy; the public traces can be compared by anyone.

relays_answered_empty: ultrasound (bid API empty for every block we queried, incl. 25914186)
auction.escalation: builder.ultrasound.money (pubkey 0x8330662d...) bid 1e-10 ETH x13 (53-107 txs) from -9674 ms, then 5.0e-6, 5.6e-6, 2.0e-5, 6.3e-5 ETH (118-136 txs) up to -1125 ms; first 1 ETH+ bid at +403 ms: 1.27695 ETH with 155 txs; then 1.27695 (+539, 156 tx), 1.27695 (+634), 1.27711 (+710, 157), 1.27897 (+805, 153 txs, block 0x2219d2c5), final 1.278614 (+1159 ms, 153 txs, block 0x0fb1f036 = the delivered block).

runner_up.note: best bid by another builder: Titan 1.00112 ETH at +3241 ms (332 txs), too late/low; best overall bid was 1.27897 ETH by the same ultrasound builder at +805 ms (not delivered)

auction.bot_tx_only_in_one_builder_family: inferred: the ~28.8 ETH tx lifts block value from ~6e-5 to ~1.28 ETH only in ultrasound-builder bids (+403 ms); no other builder bid exceeds 1.002 ETH, so the other builders' blocks apparently lacked it (relays do not reveal bid contents)

funds_fate.what: c0ffeebabe tx0 payment to builder fee recipient
no return of WBTC to the protocol seen: WBTC was sold to ETH inside the same tx
funds_fate.amount: 0.89899003 WBTC to Uniswap V3 pool for 28.848750215 WETH

reported_statements: press calls c0ffeebabe a 'white-hat MEV bot' (TechFlow/KuCoin); not verified on-chain. No public statement from the protocol found.
caveats: Block 25914188 was proposed without a relay (extraData reth/v2.2.0): no auction exists for the attacker's block.
mempool-dumpster has no source log for 2026-09; first_seen is the dump's first observation.
Relays never reveal bid contents, so which losing bids carried the bot tx is inferred only.
Real payment TX hash for proposer: see race_25914192.json txs[152].
headline_text: The attacker's public tx ran out of gas and reverted at block 25914188; 48 s later c0ffeebabe.eth's tx (block 25914192, pos 0) completed the extraction, ended with 28.85 ETH, and paid 28.84 ETH to the builder.

harmonized.verdict_reason: Bot completed the attack 4 blocks (48 s) after the attacker's public tx was mined and had failed out of gas.
